test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 1 to 6 represented as dots. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f5a8b324001161d5c3d5288821b88eb8db275079de76ec41f56e3200a753409.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f5a8b324001161d5c3d5288821b88eb8db275079de76ec41f56e3200a753409.png] 

As '2' and '4' dots are common faces on both the dice, clearly the remaining faces are opposite to each other.

Therefore, '6' will be the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

Hence, '**6**' is the correct answer.
